confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from live listings or current prices. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable, but accommodation and cocktail/wine anchors are less certain because beach-area and Stone Town rates vary widely by season, property and tourist-facing pricing. Hotel anchors assume taxes and levies are included. FX uses 2026-10-15 because the RBA exchange-rates overview confirmed that figure; a 2026-10-16 value (0.6947) appeared only in unverified third-party or summary material, so it was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is general knowledge of East African coastal tourism pricing, benchmarked to Stone Town and northern and eastern beach areas of Zanzibar and comparable Kenyan coastal resorts such as Diani and Mombasa. July is in the dry, high season, so accommodation anchors reflect peak-season rates. Cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to the beer anchor because direct knowledge of those prices is weak.
